sources.snippet: Overview Wan2.1-VAE-upscale2x is a decoder-only finetuned VAE based on the Wan2.1 architecture, developed by spacepxl. The model integrates 2x upscaling directly into the decoder while eliminating the characteristic speckle artifacts of the original Wan2.1 VAE.
